question: The slogan of which census of India was 'Our Census, Our Future'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2011.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2011 Census** was the **15th National Census of India since 1872** and was conducted under the guidance of the** Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India** in the **Ministry of Home Affairs,** Government of India.
 
• The slogan of the 2011 Census was **'Our Census, Our Future',** emphasizing the role of the census in directing future planning and resource allocation.
 
• The Census collected data on population (including gender, urban and rural distribution, literacy rate, etc.),** works, economies, and other demographic information of the country.**
 
• With nearly **2.7 million enumerators involved** in data collection, it was the** largest administrative exercise conducted by any government **in the world.
 
• The Census unveiled a wealth of valuable information including that India's population had reached **1.21 billion,** an increase of more than **181 million people over the last decade,** that the gender ratio had slightly improved, and that there had been significant strides in literacy rates.
